finalText:
380 commits, mostly dep bumps/refactors/tests, chaff. Real user-facing signal: 27 fix/feat commits, deduped by behavior (repeat titles across modules — queue/api/webhooks/db etc — kept as scope list, not repeated lines).

Wrote 4.2.0 into CHANGELOG.md:

- **Breaking**: expired token now `401` not `403`.
- **Added**: webhook deliveries retry w/ exponential backoff.
- **Fixed**: HTTP client hang-on-socket-drop + pool leak on shutdown, DB logging full request body (sensitive data — flagged first in Fixed), null-cursor crash in 4 paginators, trace id lost on API retry, duplicate header (core/billing), trailing-slash double-trim (queue/jobs), empty-allowlist errors (store/db/jobs), wrong histogram units (store/core), vague token-parser errors (core/billing/queue).

Everything else (deps, refactors, CI, test-only, docs) skipped — noise not signal. Check the Breaking entry and DB-logging fix wording match how you want it framed before shipping.
